extracted.intended_audience: newsrooms, independent journalists, podcasters, content creators, and newsroom managers seeking external research/fact-checking support
extracted.subtask_description: Providing expert research and verification services for journalists and newsrooms — locating records and sources, fact-checking longform copy, verifying multimedia and AI-generated content, and tracing misinformation — while operating under ethical transparency standards.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify backgrounds of individuals and businesses
rubrics_metrics.description: Research to verify backgrounds of people and companies for reporters working on investigative stories, newsrooms vetting prospective hires, or other cases.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes checking professional histories, affiliations, public records and other sources to corroborate claims about backgrounds; used in investigative reporting and pre-hire vetting.

rubrics_metrics.name: Find and retrieve federal and state court documents
rubrics_metrics.description: Locate and obtain court records across jurisdictions to support reporting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Specifically mentions lawsuits, marriage and dissolution of marriage records, criminal records, civil procedures and judgments; navigation of databases, archives and court systems to uncover available evidence.

rubrics_metrics.name: Identify expert sources and review for conflicts of interest
rubrics_metrics.description: Locate subject-matter experts and assess their records for potential conflicts that could affect sourcing.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Involves vetting experts’ credentials, publications, affiliations and possible conflicts of interest before recommending them as sources.

rubrics_metrics.name: Line-by-line fact-check of written work
rubrics_metrics.description: Conduct a detailed, line-by-line verification of magazine stories, longform journalism, nonfiction books and other written content.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Service checks facts, sourcing and claims throughout a manuscript or article to reduce errors and the need for later corrections.

rubrics_metrics.name: Verify videos and images for deceptive editing and AI manipulation
rubrics_metrics.description: Analyze multimedia to detect signs of deceptive editing or synthetic/AI-generated manipulation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Includes forensic review techniques to identify edits, compositing, deepfakes or other indicators of manipulation to ensure visual materials are authentic and accurately represented.

rubrics_metrics.name: Review corporate, marketing and advertising materials for accuracy, grammar and style
rubrics_metrics.description: Edit and verify corporate communications and promotional materials to ensure factual accuracy and polished presentation.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Combines factual verification with copyediting for grammar and style to produce a professional finished product suitable for publication or distribution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Vet AI-generated content
rubrics_metrics.description: Evaluate content produced by AI for factual errors and nonsensical information.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Flag factual inaccuracies and remove or correct nonsensical or misleading outputs from generative systems before publication.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trace the origin of conspiracy theories and misinformation narratives
rubrics_metrics.description: Research the provenance and evolution of false or misleading narratives online.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Map how a claim spread, identify original sources and intermediaries, and provide context that helps reporters debunk or explain misinformation to audiences.

rubrics_metrics.name: Debunk online scams
rubrics_metrics.description: Investigate and expose fraudulent online schemes promoting health products, debt relief and similar scams.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Research patterns, validate claims, identify responsible parties and produce evidence-based findings to protect audiences and support reporting on consumer scams.

rubrics_metrics.name: Independent, ethical research standards
rubrics_metrics.description: Operate under strict ethical and transparency standards to protect journalistic independence and client confidentiality.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Key policies: client details and requests remain confidential (privacy); do not work for political candidates, parties or anonymous clients (nonpartisanship); maintain clear communication and ongoing alignment on scope, priorities and deadlines (clear communication).

rubrics_metrics.name: Expertise, speed and deep-dive capability
rubrics_metrics.description: Deliver research from a team with decades of experience capable of meeting tight deadlines and uncovering evidence others may miss.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Team experience includes contributing to Pulitzer Prize-winning projects; staff are skilled at navigating specialized databases, archives and court systems to find hard-to-find facts under time pressure.

rubrics_metrics.name: Service outcomes and value propositions
rubrics_metrics.description: Intended results of engaging the service: improved factual trust, reduced risk of errors and legal exposure, and strengthened investigative and enterprise reporting without adding staff.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Benefits listed include publishing with greater trust in facts/sourcing/framing, reducing corrections and legal risk, meeting tight deadlines without sacrificing quality, and providing deep research support for limited-budget journalists.
